text:
First of all, congratulations on the new addition to the family! 😊
I believe you are currently in the visa process and already hold valid status in Israel. If the baby was born while you are lawfully residing in Israel during the process, you should go to the Tel Aviv PIBA branch and request to register the baby with the Population Registry Department.
You do not need a prior appointment for this. Please arrive at 8:00 AM on Sunday through Tuesday or Thursday and ask to be directed to the Population Registry Department (מרשם). The relevant queue is the third queue next to the windows.
You should bring birth and hospital documents with you, together with an ID and passport. Presence of both parents is required.
